title: Revealed Reinforcement and Recovery Value: Compensated Choice under State-Dependent Valuation
description: Archival release of the two-experiment compensated-choice stage of the Rational Relapse Theory research program, originally submitted as JME-D-26-00519. The paper uses compensated switching thresholds and money-metric comparisons to study state-dependent valuation, revealed reinforcement, recovery value, cross-experiment compatibility, and a common state-dependent value geometry. The release includes the English historical manuscript and a Chinese archival translation. Later archive versions further recast the project around recursive and current-choice counterfactual identification.
